newsitem.title: USA: Teleport to start service in Tennessee.
newsitem.headline: Teleport to start service in Tennessee.

text.p: Teleport Communications Group Inc said Tuesday it was authorized by the Tennessee Regulatory Authority to act as a local exchange carrier in the state.

"Tennessee's solid business market provides the ideal backdrop for competitive local phone competition," said Paul Kouroupas, the company's Eastern region vice president of regulatory and external affairs.
Kouroupas said Teleport would initially offered service to business customers in Nashville, Knoxville and Chattanooga, extending its network to other outlying areas as demand increases.
